name: kmc
description: Krista Mashore Coaching - installs a student's BOSS operating system on their computer.

plugins.name: boss-install
plugins.description:
INSTALLS YOUR BOSS SYSTEM - this is the first thing you do.

To activate, type in: install my BOSS

What it does: puts the one tool your system needs in place without ever needing your computer password; signs you in to Krista's server with the email you bought with and a code sent to it; installs your system in a folder called BOSS-OS; then opens your system in its own session, where it starts setting itself up for your business.

No GitHub account, no form, no invitation. You will never be asked to open a terminal or type a command. Takes about 15-20 minutes before the setup starts.
